summary: Iter8 verified: (a) Camps converted to informational-only in /api/leaves/event-conflicts (no institution/roster gating, 'match' field removed); (b) EventConflictNotice now uses single amber palette always with new summary 'Camps & regattas during this period · N camps · M regattas', camp-conflict-{id}/regatta-conflict-{id} chips render correctly (verified on Apply form: amber palette, 1 camp chip = Agape Sat Sun Camp); (c) Step-out TempExitCard fully revamped — 30/60/120/custom chips, default 1h selected, auto-computed ETA preview that updates on every chip-tap, custom time fallback with type=time input, submit disabled when reason empty OR (custom mode + empty time), toast reads 'Stepped out — see you by HH:MM 👋' verbatim, POST /api/attendance/temp-exit body confirmed via post-submit state transition to 'Stepped out — Lunch quickie · back by …'. Backend: 221/221 pytest pass. Frontend: All testids resolve and chip-tap → ETA reactive update works.

issues: After submitting Step-out with computed ETA '00:35' (local browser time, container clock UTC-ish), the persistent summary card displayed 'back by 07:05 PM'. The submitted toast and the in-form ETA correctly showed 00:35, but the post-submit screen renders a different HH:MM (likely a timezone conversion to Asia/Kolkata of an already-local time string). Out of strict iter8 scope (spec only required the toast text), but worth a follow-up — the server stores HH:MM as a naive string and the display layer should either treat it consistently as local time or send an ISO timestamp with TZ.

action_items: (Optional / out-of-scope for iter8) Reconcile timezone handling on the 'back by …' display in the post-step-out summary card — the toast and form ETA agree on the local time, but the persisted summary appears to apply an extra TZ offset.
critical_code_review_comments: leaves.py:190-210 — Camps query simplified to pure date-overlap (no institution / member_ids gating). Returned dict no longer carries 'match' field. Clean diff vs iter7. Both /camps and /regattas use the same MongoDB inverse-overlap pattern, consistent.

EventConflictNotice.jsx — Single amber palette is now baked in (no more red branching on camps.length). Summary line builds 'N camp(s) · M regatta(s)' with correct pluralisation. Both sections cap at 8 chips with '+N more' overflow, matching spec. data-testid scheme is symmetrical (camp-conflict-{id} / regatta-conflict-{id}).

SelfCheckIn.jsx TempExitCard (lines 318-465) — Clean implementation: STEP_OUT_DURATIONS array drives chips, computedReturn is recomputed each render (cheap, no useEffect needed), customTime fallback toggled by durationMin === null, submit disabled rule '!reason.trim() || (durationMin == null && !customTime)' covers both required-field cases. Default state durationMin=60 matches spec. fmtHmLocal helper handles HH:MM padding correctly. Submit POSTs {reason, expected_return, latitude, longitude} per spec.

Iter7 tests (test_review_iter7.py) correctly rewritten to assert informational-mode camps: test_camps_returned_for_any_user_when_overlap_exists explicitly asserts 'match' NOT in response, and test_camp_with_explicit_roster_still_returned_for_non_roster_member confirms the roster gate was removed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (221/221 pytest, 8/8 iter7 contract tests for the now-informational event-conflicts endpoint)
